# Expected changes for “The Hinterland” update on March 3rd, 2026

![Expected changes for `Das Hinterland` update on March 3rd, 2026](/uploads/621_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update March 3, 2026] Corrected

[Update 08/28/2026] Blocker description corrected, -90% self damage added, vanguard corrected (6%)

[Update 02/26/2026] Added RAID changes

The next content update for Fallout 76 will be released on **03/03/2026**. Season 23 ends and **Season 24 begins**. The update will be released under the name "**The Backwoods**" (EN: The Backwoods) and it is patch 66. We have already seen numerous changes on the PTS and I was able to introduce you to numerous new Atom Shop and seasonal items. **Unfortunately, there are no new quests, no new events, and no new raid in this update.** However, some old systems are being completely overhauled, offering a better gaming experience. 

Let's take a look at this in detail.

### Index

## 4 stars Bigfoot & Uninvited Bosses by Events (Party Crasher)

### Bigfoot

- **4 Star Boss**
- Loot:
 - **4 star loot** (1x)
 - 25% chance of the new **4 star mod "The Adventurous"**
*Increases reload speed and melee attack speed based on killstreak length.
Note: 3% per kill, Max: 30%*
 - 75% chance of getting any 4 star mod
 - 25% chance of getting the new one 
 - 5% chance: **Player title: [Partycrasher]**
*If not learned.*
 - Bottle caps
 - Various scrap items
 - Ammunition
 - Chems & Stimpaks
- **33% spawn chance** (after the following events)
- Immune to radiation
- Immune to cripple
- Immune to stagger

Can spawn after successfully completing these **Events** (33%):

- **Event: A Night of Violence**
- **Event: Stories around the campfire**
- **Event: Free Range**
- **Event: Moonshine Party**
- **Event: Pack Donkey**
- **Event: Healthy and Safe**
- [Seasonal] **Event: One-a-Bite**
- [Seasonal] **Event: Grahm`s Fleischhappa**
- [Seasonal] **Event: The Mothman Equinox**
- [Seasonal] **Event: Attacker from Space**
- [Seasonal] **Event: The Big Bloom**
